verdict.summary: The documentation-only design record remains internally consistent with the audit contract it describes. It correctly rejects corpus-derived expectations as circular, requires independent all-state worker-PR enumeration with authoritative pagination and fail-closed truncation handling, identifies the split-corpus false-revocation risk, and keeps the proposed generator separate from the offline audit. It introduces no executable trust-plane behavior, and I found no blocker or major correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue. Because round 1 also had no findings and the diff presents no material review-relevant change, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
